My Pillu,

13 months ago, I didn't know all the little things that would become my favourite parts of life. Your voice, our silly talks, the way I wait for your calls, and all the memories we've collected without even noticing.

I know we haven't had only easy days. I don't want to promise you a perfect story. I want to keep showing up, keep understanding you, and keep making this feel like a place where you can be yourself.

Thank you for being my person. I hope this little corner of the internet makes you smile today.

Happy 13 months, Pillu.

Yours,
Jay ♡
